title: Haliade-X 離岸風機平台
summary: 奇異的 Haliade-X 於 2019 年在鹿特丹豎起 12 MW 原型機，葉輪直徑 220 m、葉片長 107 m，其後陸續提升到 13 與 14 MW，用於英國與美國的大型風場；2024 年它的葉片在兩座風場先後發生損壞。課程定量分析同一葉輪上提升容量的意義、葉根承受的離心力，以及在海上更換葉片的成本。
summaryEn: GE's Haliade-X raised its 12 MW prototype at Rotterdam in 2019 with a 220 m rotor and 107 m blades, was later uprated to 13 and 14 MW and went to large farms in Britain and the United States; in 2024 its blades were damaged at two farms in turn. The course quantifies what uprating on the same rotor means, centrifugal force at the blade root, and cost of changing blades at sea.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 首款超過 12 MW 的離岸風機平台：同一葉輪的容量提升、葉根離心力與海上換葉片的代價
v30FocusEn: The first offshore turbine platform above 12 MW: uprating on one rotor, centrifugal force at the blade root and the cost of changing blades at sea

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：Haliade-X 離岸風機平台
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Haliade-X Offshore Wind Turbine Platform
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「掃掠面積與比功率」與「年發電量與容量因數」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Swept area and specific power" and "Annual energy and capacity factor": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「掃掠面積與比功率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Swept area and specific power" is correct?
options: 風機能捕獲多少能量，首先取決於葉輪掃過的面積，它與葉輪直徑的平方成正比。
風機的發電量只看額定功率，葉片長短不重要。
風場的容量因數只有四成多，表示有一半以上的時間風機停著不動。
optionsEn: How much energy a turbine can capture depends first on the area swept by the rotor, proportional to rotor diameter squared.
A turbine's energy yield depends only on rated power; blade length does not matter.
A capacity factor of forty-odd percent means the turbines stand idle more than half the time.
quiz.explanation: 風機能捕獲多少能量，首先取決於葉輪掃過的面積，它與葉輪直徑的平方成正比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: How much energy a turbine can capture depends first on the area swept by the rotor, proportional to rotor diameter squared. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 掃掠面積與比功率：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Swept area and specific power: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「掃掠面積與比功率」如何決定「Haliade-X 離岸風機平台」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Swept area and specific power” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Haliade-X Offshore Wind Turbine Platform”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 風機能捕獲多少能量，首先取決於葉輪掃過的面積，它與葉輪直徑的平方成正比。額定功率除以掃掠面積稱為比功率：比功率低（大葉輪配小發電機）的風機在中低風速就接近滿載，容量因數高、出力平穩；比功率高的風機造價較低，但只有在強風場址才划算。現代離岸風機直徑超過 200 公尺，單機掃掠面積相當於數個足球場。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: How much energy a turbine can capture depends first on the area swept by the rotor, proportional to rotor diameter squared. Rated power divided by swept area is specific power: a low value, a big rotor on a small generator, reaches full load at moderate wind and gives high capacity factor and steadier output, while a high value is cheaper but pays only at windy sites. Modern offshore rotors exceed 200 m, sweeping the area of several football pitches each. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：原型機額定 12 MW，葉輪直徑 220 m，2019 年 11 月首次發電
steps.observationEn: Project file: The prototype was rated 12 MW with a 220 m rotor and first generated in November 2019
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機的發電量只看額定功率，葉片長短不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A turbine's energy yield depends only on rated power; blade length does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「掃掠面積與比功率」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Swept area and specific power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 掃掠面積與比功率
knowledge.text: 風機能捕獲多少能量，首先取決於葉輪掃過的面積，它與葉輪直徑的平方成正比。額定功率除以掃掠面積稱為比功率：比功率低（大葉輪配小發電機）的風機在中低風速就接近滿載，容量因數高、出力平穩；比功率高的風機造價較低，但只有在強風場址才划算。現代離岸風機直徑超過 200 公尺，單機掃掠面積相當於數個足球場。
knowledge.textEn: How much energy a turbine can capture depends first on the area swept by the rotor, proportional to rotor diameter squared. Rated power divided by swept area is specific power: a low value, a big rotor on a small generator, reaches full load at moderate wind and gives high capacity factor and steadier output, while a high value is cheaper but pays only at windy sites. Modern offshore rotors exceed 200 m, sweeping the area of several football pitches each.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風機的發電量只看額定功率，葉片長短不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A turbine's energy yield depends only on rated power; blade length does not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 原型機額定 12 MW，葉輪直徑 220 m，2019 年 11 月首次發電
knowledge.textEn: The prototype was rated 12 MW with a 220 m rotor and first generated in November 2019

quiz.question: 依「掃掠面積與比功率」的模型 P/A = P_r / (π·D²/4)，額定功率與掃掠面積之比最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model P/A = P_r / (π·D²/4) for "Swept area and specific power", which value is closest to the rated power per unit swept area?
options: 158 W/m²
316 W/m²
optionsEn: 158 W/m²
316 W/m²
quiz.explanation: P/A = P_r / (π·D²/4)；代入 Pr = 12 MW、D = 220 m，得 316 W/m²（額定功率與掃掠面積之比）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: P/A = P_r / (π·D²/4); with Pr = 12 MW, D = 220 m the result is 316 W/m² (rated power per unit swept area). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 掃掠面積與比功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Swept area and specific power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「掃掠面積與比功率」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Swept area and specific power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：P/A = P_r / (π·D²/4)；代入 Pr = 12 MW、D = 220 m，得 316 W/m²（額定功率與掃掠面積之比）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 D 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: P/A = P_r / (π·D²/4); with Pr = 12 MW, D = 220 m the result is 316 W/m² (rated power per unit swept area). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise D by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：D 增加 10% 時，結果變為 261 W/m²（-17.4%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising D by 10% changes the result to 261 W/m² (-17.4%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 316 W/m²（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 D 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 316 W/m² (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in D with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: P/A = P_r / (π·D²/4)；代入 Pr = 12 MW、D = 220 m，得 316 W/m²（額定功率與掃掠面積之比）。
knowledge.textEn: P/A = P_r / (π·D²/4); with Pr = 12 MW, D = 220 m the result is 316 W/m² (rated power per unit swept area).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: D 增加 10% 時，結果變為 261 W/m²（-17.4%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising D by 10% changes the result to 261 W/m² (-17.4%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「掃掠面積與比功率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Swept area and specific power"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
大型風機的葉片轉得很慢，所以葉尖的速度也很慢。
由型式認證文件核對葉輪直徑與額定功率，並在功率曲線量測中確認達到額定功率的風速是否與比功率相符。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The blades of a large turbine turn slowly, so the tips move slowly too.
Check rotor diameter and rated power in the type certificate, and confirm in power-curve measurement that the wind speed at which rated power is reached is consistent with the specific power.
quiz.explanation: 由型式認證文件核對葉輪直徑與額定功率，並在功率曲線量測中確認達到額定功率的風速是否與比功率相符。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check rotor diameter and rated power in the type certificate, and confirm in power-curve measurement that the wind speed at which rated power is reached is consistent with the specific power. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 掃掠面積與比功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Swept area and specific power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「掃掠面積與比功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Swept area and specific power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 由型式認證文件核對葉輪直徑與額定功率，並在功率曲線量測中確認達到額定功率的風速是否與比功率相符。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check rotor diameter and rated power in the type certificate, and confirm in power-curve measurement that the wind speed at which rated power is reached is consistent with the specific power. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：機型比較表要同時列出額定功率、葉輪直徑、比功率與場址風速分布下的預估年發電量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Model comparisons should list rated power, rotor diameter, specific power and estimated annual energy for the site wind distribution together.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在低風速場址選用高比功率機型，會使機組大部分時間在部分負載運轉，容量因數與收益遠低於預期。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Choosing a high specific-power model for a low-wind site leaves the turbine at part load most of the time, with capacity factor and revenue far below expectation. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 由型式認證文件核對葉輪直徑與額定功率，並在功率曲線量測中確認達到額定功率的風速是否與比功率相符。
knowledge.textEn: Check rotor diameter and rated power in the type certificate, and confirm in power-curve measurement that the wind speed at which rated power is reached is consistent with the specific power.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 機型比較表要同時列出額定功率、葉輪直徑、比功率與場址風速分布下的預估年發電量。
knowledge.textEn: Model comparisons should list rated power, rotor diameter, specific power and estimated annual energy for the site wind distribution together.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 61400-1 風力機設計要求。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 61400-1 Wind energy generation systems – Design requirements. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「掃掠面積與比功率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Swept area and specific power" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 在低風速場址選用高比功率機型，會使機組大部分時間在部分負載運轉，容量因數與收益遠低於預期。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
風場的容量因數只有四成多，表示有一半以上的時間風機停著不動。
optionsEn: Choosing a high specific-power model for a low-wind site leaves the turbine at part load most of the time, with capacity factor and revenue far below expectation.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
A capacity factor of forty-odd percent means the turbines stand idle more than half the time.
quiz.explanation: 在低風速場址選用高比功率機型，會使機組大部分時間在部分負載運轉，容量因數與收益遠低於預期。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Choosing a high specific-power model for a low-wind site leaves the turbine at part load most of the time, with capacity factor and revenue far below expectation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 掃掠面積與比功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Swept area and specific power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「掃掠面積與比功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Swept area and specific power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在低風速場址選用高比功率機型，會使機組大部分時間在部分負載運轉，容量因數與收益遠低於預期。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「Haliade-X 離岸風機平台」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Choosing a high specific-power model for a low-wind site leaves the turbine at part load most of the time, with capacity factor and revenue far below expectation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Haliade-X Offshore Wind Turbine Platform”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：現代離岸風機直徑超過 200 公尺，單機掃掠面積相當於數個足球場。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Modern offshore rotors exceed 200 m, sweeping the area of several football pitches each.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風機的發電量只看額定功率，葉片長短不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A turbine's energy yield depends only on rated power; blade length does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在低風速場址選用高比功率機型，會使機組大部分時間在部分負載運轉，容量因數與收益遠低於預期。
knowledge.textEn: Choosing a high specific-power model for a low-wind site leaves the turbine at part load most of the time, with capacity factor and revenue far below expectation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

options: 風場的容量因數只有四成多，表示有一半以上的時間風機停著不動。
只要葉片設計得夠好，風機可以把風的能量百分之百轉成電。
風場的年發電量等於裝置容量乘以全年時數再乘以容量因數。

With good enough blades a turbine can convert all the wind's energy into electricity.
Annual energy of a wind farm is installed capacity times hours in the year times capacity factor.
quiz.explanation: 風場的年發電量等於裝置容量乘以全年時數再乘以容量因數。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Annual energy of a wind farm is installed capacity times hours in the year times capacity factor. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 年發電量與容量因數：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Annual energy and capacity factor: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「年發電量與容量因數」如何決定「Haliade-X 離岸風機平台」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Annual energy and capacity factor” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Haliade-X Offshore Wind Turbine Platform”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 風場的年發電量等於裝置容量乘以全年時數再乘以容量因數。離岸風場因風速高且穩定，容量因數可達 40% 至 55%，高於多數陸域風場。從理論毛發電量到可售電量，還要扣除尾流、電氣損失、可用率與棄電等項目；融資時使用的 P50、P90 發電量，就是把這些損失與風資源的年際變異都納入後的機率估計。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Annual energy of a wind farm is installed capacity times hours in the year times capacity factor. Offshore farms, with higher and steadier wind, reach 40–55%, above most onshore farms. From gross theoretical yield to saleable energy, wake, electrical losses, availability and curtailment must be deducted; the P50 and P90 yields used in financing are probability estimates including these losses and year-to-year wind variability. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：葉片長 107 m，是當時世界最長的風機葉片
steps.observationEn: Project file: The blade is 107 m long, then the longest turbine blade in the world
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風場的容量因數只有四成多，表示有一半以上的時間風機停著不動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A capacity factor of forty-odd percent means the turbines stand idle more than half the time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「年發電量與容量因數」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Annual energy and capacity factor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 年發電量與容量因數
knowledge.text: 風場的年發電量等於裝置容量乘以全年時數再乘以容量因數。離岸風場因風速高且穩定，容量因數可達 40% 至 55%，高於多數陸域風場。從理論毛發電量到可售電量，還要扣除尾流、電氣損失、可用率與棄電等項目；融資時使用的 P50、P90 發電量，就是把這些損失與風資源的年際變異都納入後的機率估計。
knowledge.textEn: Annual energy of a wind farm is installed capacity times hours in the year times capacity factor. Offshore farms, with higher and steadier wind, reach 40–55%, above most onshore farms. From gross theoretical yield to saleable energy, wake, electrical losses, availability and curtailment must be deducted; the P50 and P90 yields used in financing are probability estimates including these losses and year-to-year wind variability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風場的容量因數只有四成多，表示有一半以上的時間風機停著不動。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A capacity factor of forty-odd percent means the turbines stand idle more than half the time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 葉片長 107 m，是當時世界最長的風機葉片
knowledge.textEn: The blade is 107 m long, then the longest turbine blade in the world

quiz.question: 依「年發電量與容量因數」的模型 E = P·8760·CF，風場的年淨發電量（容量因數為公開或代表值）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model E = P·8760·CF for "Annual energy and capacity factor", which value is closest to the annual net energy of the farm (capacity factor public or representative)?
options: 63.1 GWh
631 GWh
31.5 GWh
optionsEn: 63.1 GWh
631 GWh
31.5 GWh
quiz.explanation: E = P·8760·CF；代入 Ptot = 12 MW、CFw = 0.6，得 63.1 GWh（風場的年淨發電量（容量因數為公開或代表值））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: E = P·8760·CF; with Ptot = 12 MW, CFw = 0.6 the result is 63.1 GWh (annual net energy of the farm (capacity factor public or representative)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 年發電量與容量因數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Annual energy and capacity factor: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「年發電量與容量因數」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Annual energy and capacity factor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：E = P·8760·CF；代入 Ptot = 12 MW、CFw = 0.6，得 63.1 GWh（風場的年淨發電量（容量因數為公開或代表值））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 CFw 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: E = P·8760·CF; with Ptot = 12 MW, CFw = 0.6 the result is 63.1 GWh (annual net energy of the farm (capacity factor public or representative)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise CFw by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：CFw 增加 10% 時，結果變為 69.4 GWh（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising CFw by 10% changes the result to 69.4 GWh (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 63.1 GWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 CFw 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 63.1 GWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in CFw with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: E = P·8760·CF；代入 Ptot = 12 MW、CFw = 0.6，得 63.1 GWh（風場的年淨發電量（容量因數為公開或代表值））。
knowledge.textEn: E = P·8760·CF; with Ptot = 12 MW, CFw = 0.6 the result is 63.1 GWh (annual net energy of the farm (capacity factor public or representative)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: CFw 增加 10% 時，結果變為 69.4 GWh（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising CFw by 10% changes the result to 69.4 GWh (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「年發電量與容量因數」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Annual energy and capacity factor"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以關口電表的逐年發電量核對，並把實績與風況指數（當年風速相對於長期平均）做正規化，分辨是風況差還是設備表現差。
結構做得越硬越安全，所以自然頻率越高越好。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Check against yearly revenue-meter energy and normalise by a wind index, the year's wind relative to the long-term mean, to tell a poor wind year from poor plant performance.
A stiffer structure is always safer, so the higher the natural frequency the better.
quiz.explanation: 以關口電表的逐年發電量核對，並把實績與風況指數（當年風速相對於長期平均）做正規化，分辨是風況差還是設備表現差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check against yearly revenue-meter energy and normalise by a wind index, the year's wind relative to the long-term mean, to tell a poor wind year from poor plant performance. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 年發電量與容量因數：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Annual energy and capacity factor: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「年發電量與容量因數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Annual energy and capacity factor” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以關口電表的逐年發電量核對，並把實績與風況指數（當年風速相對於長期平均）做正規化，分辨是風況差還是設備表現差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check against yearly revenue-meter energy and normalise by a wind index, the year's wind relative to the long-term mean, to tell a poor wind year from poor plant performance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：營運報告要把發電量差異拆成風況、可用率、電氣損失與棄電四項，並逐年與投前評估比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Operating reports should split yield variance into wind, availability, electrical loss and curtailment, compared with the pre-construction assessment every year.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：發電量評估若低估尾流與阻塞效應，或高估可用率，投產後的實績長期低於 P50，直接影響還款能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the yield assessment underestimates wake and blockage or overestimates availability, production stays below P50 after commissioning and directly affects debt service. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以關口電表的逐年發電量核對，並把實績與風況指數（當年風速相對於長期平均）做正規化，分辨是風況差還是設備表現差。
knowledge.textEn: Check against yearly revenue-meter energy and normalise by a wind index, the year's wind relative to the long-term mean, to tell a poor wind year from poor plant performance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 營運報告要把發電量差異拆成風況、可用率、電氣損失與棄電四項，並逐年與投前評估比較。
knowledge.textEn: Operating reports should split yield variance into wind, availability, electrical loss and curtailment, compared with the pre-construction assessment every year.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 61400-3 離岸風力機設計要求。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 61400-3 Design requirements for fixed and floating offshore wind turbines. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「年發電量與容量因數」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Annual energy and capacity factor" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
只要葉片設計得夠好，風機可以把風的能量百分之百轉成電。
發電量評估若低估尾流與阻塞效應，或高估可用率，投產後的實績長期低於 P50，直接影響還款能力。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
With good enough blades a turbine can convert all the wind's energy into electricity.
If the yield assessment underestimates wake and blockage or overestimates availability, production stays below P50 after commissioning and directly affects debt service.
quiz.explanation: 發電量評估若低估尾流與阻塞效應，或高估可用率，投產後的實績長期低於 P50，直接影響還款能力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the yield assessment underestimates wake and blockage or overestimates availability, production stays below P50 after commissioning and directly affects debt service. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 年發電量與容量因數：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Annual energy and capacity factor: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「年發電量與容量因數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Annual energy and capacity factor” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 發電量評估若低估尾流與阻塞效應，或高估可用率，投產後的實績長期低於 P50，直接影響還款能力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「Haliade-X 離岸風機平台」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: If the yield assessment underestimates wake and blockage or overestimates availability, production stays below P50 after commissioning and directly affects debt service. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Haliade-X Offshore Wind Turbine Platform”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：從理論毛發電量到可售電量，還要扣除尾流、電氣損失、可用率與棄電等項目；融資時使用的 P50、P90 發電量，就是把這些損失與風資源的年際變異都納入後的機率估計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: From gross theoretical yield to saleable energy, wake, electrical losses, availability and curtailment must be deducted; the P50 and P90 yields used in financing are probability estimates including these losses and year-to-year wind variability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風場的容量因數只有四成多，表示有一半以上的時間風機停著不動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A capacity factor of forty-odd percent means the turbines stand idle more than half the time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 發電量評估若低估尾流與阻塞效應，或高估可用率，投產後的實績長期低於 P50，直接影響還款能力。
knowledge.textEn: If the yield assessment underestimates wake and blockage or overestimates availability, production stays below P50 after commissioning and directly affects debt service.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
